none: PAS NLM-6AB315: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), issue of 324-330, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped left. Obverse inscription: [--]IVS NOB C. Reverse description: Camp gate with two towers, star above. Reverse inscription: [PROVIDENTIAE CAESS]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.63gms, die axis: 6
